Name: Finesse Shot
Info: A player who is known to try and place the ball when shooting at goal.
Playstyle: Performs finesse shots faster with additional curve and improved accuracy.
Playstyle+: Performs finesse shots significantly faster with maximum curve and exceptional accuracy.

Name: Chip Shot
Info: A player who is known to often try to chip the goalkeeper when shooting at goal.
Playstyle: Performs chip shots faster and with greater accuracy.
Playstyle+: Performs chip shots more quickly with exceptional accuracy.

Name: Power Shot
Info: A player who is known for taking powerful shots from outside the box.
Playstyle: Performs power shots faster and with increased speed.
Playstyle+: Performs power shots much faster and with a significant increase in speed.

Name: Dead Ball
Info: A player who is known for being a specialist at taking set pieces.
Playstyle: Set pieces are delivered with increased speed, curve, and accuracy. Ball trajectory preview line is longer.
Playstyle+: Set pieces are delivered with exceptional speed, curve, and accuracy. Ball trajectory preview line is at maximum length.

Name: Precision Header
Info: An offensive player who is known for controlled and accurate headers, excelling in aerial battles rather than relying on raw power.
Playstyle: Performs headers with increased accuracy and power.
Playstyle+: Performs headers with greatly increased accuracy and power.

Name: Acrobatic
Info: A player who tends to perform acrobatic passes, clearances, and shots.
Playstyle: Performs volleys with improved accuracy and has access to acrobatic volley animations.
Playstyle+: Performs volleys with significant accuracy and has access to unique acrobatic volley animations.

Name: Low Driven Shot
Info: A player who can execute precise shots with increased shot accuracy.
Playstyle: Enhances a player's ability to execute low driven shots with increased accuracy, faster ball travel, and quicker shot execution.
Playstyle+: Enhances a player's ability to perform low driven shots with significantly enhanced accuracy, even faster ball travel, and quicker shot execution.

Name: Gamechanger
Info: A player who is known for extraordinary and unconventional finishes, excelling at creative and unpredictable shots.
Playstyle: Fancy and Trivela shots are performed with improved accuracy.
Playstyle+: Fancy and Trivela shots are performed with greatly improved accuracy.

Name: Incisive Pass
Info: A player who is known for making defense-splitting passes for a teammate to run onto.
Playstyle: Through Passes are more accurate, Swerve Passes are delivered with more curve, and Precision Passes travel faster to the destination.
Playstyle+: Through Passes are far more accurate, Swerve Passes are delivered with maximum curve, and Precision Passes travel at top speed to the destination.

Name: Pinged Pass
Info: A player who is known for making high speed ground passes.
Playstyle: Passes travel faster along the ground without impacting the trapping difficulty of the receiver.
Playstyle+: Passes travel much faster along the ground without impacting the trapping difficulty of the receiver.

Name: Long Ball Pass
Info: A player who is known for performing lobbed long passes to teammates.
Playstyle: Lob and Lofted Through Passes are more accurate, travel faster, and are more difficult to intercept.
Playstyle+: Lob and Lofted Through Passes are even more accurate, travel faster than ever, and are far more difficult to intercept.

Name: Tiki Taka
Info: A player who is known for making first-time accurate and short passes.
Playstyle: Executes difficult first-time Ground Passes with high accuracy, using backheels when contextually appropriate. Short distance Ground Passes are highly accurate.
Playstyle+: Executes difficult first-time Ground Passes with even greater accuracy, using backheels when contextually appropriate. Short distance Ground Passes are exceptionally accurate.

Name: Whipped Pass
Info: A player who is known for making high-speed whipped crosses into the box.
Playstyle: All crosses are highly accurate, travel faster, and with more curve.
Playstyle+: All crosses are highly accurate, travel faster, and with more curve. Performs driven crosses with exceptional power.

Name: Inventive
Info: A player who is known for creative passing and the ability to perform clever, unpredictable combinations.
Playstyle: Fancy and Trivela passes are performed with improved accuracy.
Playstyle+: Fancy and Trivela passes are performed with greatly improved accuracy.

Name: Jockey
Info: A player who is known for being successful in 1v1 situations.
Playstyle: Increased max speed of Sprint Jockey and improved transition speed from jockey to sprint.
Playstyle+: Increased max speed of Sprint Jockey and greatly improves transition speed from jockey to sprint.

Name: Block
Info: A player who is known for performing elastic and overreaching blocks.
Playstyle: Increased reach when performing blocks and improved ability to make a successful block.
Playstyle+: Even greater reach when performing blocks and improved ability to make a successful block.

Name: Intercept
Info: A player who is known for performing interceptions and keeping ball possession.
Playstyle: Increased reach and improved chances of retaining possession of the ball when performing interceptions.
Playstyle+: Even greater reach and improved chances of retaining possession of the ball when performing interceptions.

Name: Anticipate
Info: A player who is known for having a high success rate getting ball possession on tackles with a low fouling rate.
Playstyle: Improved chances of standing tackle success and grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a standing tackle.
Playstyle+: Significantly improved chances of standing tackle success and grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a standing tackle.

Name: Slide Tackle
Info: A player who is known for often performing slide tackles.
Playstyle: Grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a slide tackle.
Playstyle+: Greatly improved slide tackle coverage. Also grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a slide tackle.

Name: Aerial Fortress
Info: A defensive player who is known for dominating aerial battles in defensive situations.
Playstyle: Performs higher jumps and has increased physical presence before and during defensive aerial duels.
Playstyle+: Performs even higher jumps and has greatly increased physical presence before and during defensive aerial duels.

Name: Technical
Info: A player who regularly tries to beat an opponent by using technical dribbling ability (with little to no use of skill moves or little to no physical contact).
Playstyle: Reaches a higher speed when performing Controlled Sprint and performs wide turns while dribbling with more precision.
Playstyle+: Reaches even higher speed when performing Controlled Sprint and performs wide turns while dribbling with greater precision.

Name: Rapid
Info: A player who is known to use speed and knock the ball ahead of their opponent to beat them whilst dribbling.
Playstyle: Reaches a higher sprint speed while dribbling and has reduced chance of an error when sprinting or performing knock-ons.
Playstyle+: Reaches even higher sprint speed while dribbling and has greatly reduced chance of an error when sprinting or performing knock-ons.

Name: First Touch
Info: A player who is known for accurate first touch control in difficult situations.
Playstyle: Has reduced error when trapping the ball and is able to transition to dribbling faster with greater control.
Playstyle+: Has minimal error when trapping the ball and is able to transition to dribbling much faster with greater control.

Name: Trickster
Info: A player who is known for being able to perform skill moves in 1v1 situations.
Playstyle: Grants the ability to perform unique flick Skill Moves.
Playstyle+: Grants the ability to perform more unique ground and flick Skill Moves. Is significantly more agile when strafe dribbling.

Name: Press Proven
Info: A player who is known for keeping ball possession under physical pressure from the opponent.
Playstyle: Keeps close control of the ball while dribbling at jog speed and can shield the ball more effectively from stronger opponents.
Playstyle+: Keeps exceptionally close control of the ball while dribbling at jog speed. Can shield the ball much more effectively from stronger opponents.

Name: Quick Step
Info: A player who is known to have a quick burst of speed when accelerating on and off the ball.
Playstyle: Accelerates faster during Explosive Sprint.
Playstyle+: Accelerates significantly faster during Explosive Sprint.

Name: Relentless
Info: A player who is known for covering a greater area of the field compared to other players in the same position.
Playstyle: Reduces fatigue loss during play and increases fatigue recovery during halftime.
Playstyle+: Greatly reduces the long-term fatigue effects on attributes, reaction time, and defensive awareness. Reduces fatigue loss during play and significantly increases fatigue recovery during halftime.

Name: Long Throw
Info: A player who is known to throw the ball further than the average player.
Playstyle: Performs throw-ins with increased power to cover a greater distance.
Playstyle+: Performs throw-ins with more power to cover maximum distance.

Name: Bruiser
Info: A player who is known for winning possession by physical imposition.
Playstyle: Greater strength when performing physical tackles.
Playstyle+: Even greater strength when performing physical tackles.

Name: Enforcer
Info: A physical attacker who is known for controlling the ball through shielding and initiating contact while dribbling.
Playstyle: Performs dribble Shoulder Challenges and Shielding with increased effectiveness.
Playstyle+: Performs dribble Shoulder Challenges and Shielding with greatly increased effectiveness.
